dedupe_keys.name: northern java coastline gnss land subsidence time series

description: The Java GNSS team publishes three-dimensional displacement time series from 20 continuous stations along the northern coastline of Java, including Jakarta, Pekalongan, Semarang and Demak. The public Zenodo record is CC BY 4.0. The article says the observations span 2010 to 2021 and are referenced to ITRF2014. A coastal modeller can use them to check local subsidence assumptions in flood or drainage exposure simulations. A caveat is that station motion may combine tectonic, groundwater and local effects, and a point measurement does not describe uniform settlement across a city. The earlier candidate was rejected from a digital-infrastructure sweep, but the hazard and urban exposure use falls within this review's cross-cutting scope. I read the own Zenodo metadata and article Data Records without downloading station files, processing GNSS observations or estimating inundation. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
